summary: Session-4 backend features fully verified: 18/18 pass in /app/backend/tests/test_babybabel_session4.py (run serially with -n0). Coverage: (A) Weekly availability PATCH /api/tutors/me/profile — sets {mon:['09:00','10:00'], tue:['09:00']}, normalizes '9:00'->'09:00', drops 'bogus', prunes empty-day arrays; GET returns the same sorted+zero-padded dict. (B) GET /api/tutors/{id}/booked-slots returns [{date,time}] with time normalized; the freshly created next-Monday@10:00 booking shows up. (C) Booking slot enforcement: unavailable time (07:00) => 400 with "isn't available" copy; available time => 200 with the correct fee math; second identical slot => 409; au-pair booking with lessons_count=30 at 07:00 bypasses slot check and succeeds. (D) 1% fee math: 60-min booking @ 3500¢/hr => base=3500, platform_fee_cents=35, amount_cents=3535 (exact match). (E) POST /api/bookings/{id}/confirm-mock as booking owner sets payment_status=paid AND inserts one document into db.platform_earnings — GET /api/admin/earnings total_cents & count both increment by exactly 35 / 1; second confirm-mock call is idempotent (no new earnings entry); GET /api/admin/stats exposes platform_earnings_cents & platform_earnings_count. (F) Invitation slot enforcement: tutor invitation at 07:00 (outside weekly_availability) => 400 with "outside your weekly availability"; invitation at already-booked 10:00 => 409. (G) Auth hardening: signup with password 'abc' returns 422 (Pydantic min_length=8, fires before rate-limit — good UX); duplicate signup for sofia@babybabel.dev returns 400 with generic detail "We couldn't create that account. Try logging in or use a different email." — no 'already registered' leak; 8 consecutive bad-password logins for parent@test.dev trip the 300s / 8-hit sliding window on the 9th call and return 429. Stripe fallback correctly logs mock pi_mock_* ids when the key is invalid — this is the expected code path in this env.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 1512 lines. Splitting into modules (auth, tutors, bookings, admin) is overdue but not blocking.

The parent-facing double-booking message ('That slot was just booked by someone else') is user-friendly but is_slot_booked ignores canceled bookings — that's correct. Consider also excluding 'failed' payments so a failed-payment slot can be re-tried; currently a failed-payment booking will permanently block the slot until the Stripe webhook flips it to 'canceled'.

credit_platform_fee() writes admin_user_id from the FIRST admin found in db.users — fine now, but if you ever seed multiple admins the ledger will silently attribute every fee to the same one. Consider dropping admin_user_id or storing None.
PLATFORM_FEE_BPS uses max(1, round(...)) for non-zero base amounts — a 1-cent minimum fee is applied even for tiny bookings. That's likely desired but flag it for product review.
The rate limiter is in-memory & per-pod: horizontal scaling will not share buckets. Fine for MVP; note for future.

Pydantic validation on SignupRequest runs BEFORE the signup rate_limit() call, so short-password attempts don't consume the 5/600s budget. That's a subtle plus — attackers can't burn tokens via 422s. Keep an eye on this if the endpoint is ever refactored.

test_babybabel_session4.py uses class-scoped instance-method fixture (`fresh_parent`) which triggers a pytest deprecation warning (PytestRemovedIn10Warning). Not blocking but should switch to @classmethod when the codebase upgrades to pytest 10.

An autouse fixture pre-scrubs any lingering Sofia bookings for next Monday @ 07:00/10:00 from prior test runs (+ their platform_earnings rows) so the suite is fully re-runnable.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run with `pytest backend/tests/test_babybabel_session4.py -v -n0` (serial). Parallel xdist will race the login rate-limit test against fixture setup and fail unrelated tests with 429. If you hit a 429 during iteration, `sudo supervisorctl restart backend` clears the in-memory rate buckets. The autouse cleanup uses pymongo — MONGO_URL is loaded from backend/.env. Sofia's `weekly_availability` is left set to {mon:['09:00','10:00'], tue:['09:00']} after the run — reset via a PATCH if you need a virgin tutor.
rca_of_issue: No open bugs. Two testing gotchas encountered: (1) initial parallel xdist run (2 workers) fired the login-rate-limit test on gw1 while gw0's fixtures were still logging in Sofia/admin, causing setup errors in unrelated tests — fixed by forcing -n0 (serial). (2) test_b2_booking_succeeds_with_fee returned 409 because a stale booking from a prior test iteration was still in the DB at Sofia + next-Monday@10:00 — fixed by adding a session-scoped autouse fixture that deletes those specific stale docs via pymongo before the suite starts.
